headline: Air Traffic Controller Poaching Highlights Global Staffing Shortages
summary: Officials warn that air traffic controller poaching exposes severe global staffing shortage risks across aviation infrastructure.
why: Labor shortages in critical aviation roles can constrain flight capacities and affect the operational efficiency of transport networks.

impacts.name: Aviation Industry
impacts.why: Staffing shortages and poaching risks constrain operational capacity.
